commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+2' Alejandro Quintero has issued a yellow card to Javi Puado (Espanyol).
90+2' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
90+1' Although Jofre (Espanyol) is just on the bench, Alejandro Quintero has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

88' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall. Espanyol force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' Diego Conde (Villarreal) receives a yellow card.
85' Diego Conde (Villarreal) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle.
85' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Corner kicks – 3:1.
80' Here is a change. Jofre is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Irvin Cardona (Espanyol).
80' Here's the change. Ilias Akhomach leaves the pitch and Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
80' Naci Unuvar (Espanyol) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
79' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Diego Conde, who smothers the ball.
78' A pass by Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
76' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Quintero didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ayoze Perez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
74' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Pau Navarro (Villarreal) replaces Logan Costa.
73' A substitution has been made. Pol Lozano goes off and Jose Gragera (Espanyol) comes on.
72' It will be a substitution. Naci Unuvar (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Brian Olivan walks off.
72' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Alejo Veliz will be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Espanyol).
72' Villarreal exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
68' The cross into the penalty area from Alex Kral (Espanyol) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Denis Suarez (Villarreal) is replacing Alex Baena.
65' Santi Comesana goes off the pitch and Dani Parejo (Villarreal) comes on.
65' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
64' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Alvaro Tejero and he is replaced by Carlos Romero (Espanyol).

63' 1 - 2 Alex Baena passes to Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:2.
63' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
60' Jofre (Espanyol) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
59' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
58' Foul! Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
54' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

53' Javi Puado (Espanyol) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Javi Puado (Espanyol) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Espanyol force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
51' The ball is out of play. Villarreal will take a throw-in.
50' Villarreal keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
47' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
46' Javi Puado (Espanyol) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
46' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is booked.
46' Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) receives a yellow card for infringement.
46' Manolo Gonzalez has made a change at the break. Sergi Gomez (Espanyol) has come on in place of Leandro Cabrera.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+10' One of the Villarreal players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
45+6' 1 - 1 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!
45+4' Espanyol are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
45+1' 1 - 0 Jofre (Espanyol) creates some space for himself just outside the penalty area after getting on the end of an amazing pass and smashes the ball into the back of the net!
45' 8 additional min. will be played.
45' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
44' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
43' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
41' Espanyol work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
39' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
38' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
36' Problems for Marcelino as Raul Albiol is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Eric Bailly (Villarreal) replaces him.
30' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
30' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
29' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
28' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
26' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
26' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Villarreal.

25' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

22' That didn't go as planned! Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Joan Garcia, who easily kept it out.
21' A cross from Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
20' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
20' Espanyol are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
15' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
15' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
14' Jofre (Espanyol) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
13' Jofre (Espanyol) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
10' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
7' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Villarreal are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Villarreal concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
3' A player from Espanyol takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
1' The ball is behind the touchline and Villarreal will take a throw-in.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Espanyol produce a short pass from the free kick.
Villarreal will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Quintero.
